examples.claim: Lysine histone demethylase inhibitor JIB 04 is inactive against KDM5A.
examples.excerpt: Here, using an innovative cell-based screen, we identify a structurally unique small molecule (named JIB-04) that specifically inhibits the activity of the Jumonji family of histone demethylases in vitro, in cancer cells, and in tumours in vivo.
examples.reason: The passage is on the same topic but does not state the claimed result or its opposite, so it neither supports nor refutes the claim [1].

examples.claim: Major antigen-induced signals from the T cell receptor and secondary signals from costimulatory receptors are required for T cell activation.
examples.excerpt: Ligation of the CD28 receptor on T cells provides a critical second signal alongside T cell receptor (TCR) ligation for naive T cell activation.
examples.reason: The passage reports this finding in different words, so it supports the claim [1].

examples.claim: Incidence of 10/66 dementia is lower than the incidence of DSM-IV dementia.
